---
description: Produce your gate submission summary to paste into the gate form
---

Read every file in `./growth-engine/`.

Produce a short plain-text block the founder can paste into the gate form. Include:

- Founder name and business
- Track (b2b or b2c)
- Which files exist, one per line
- For each gate item, DONE or NOT DONE
- Any unresolved flags from the Brain, especially domain status for B2B and Instagram account type for B2C

Be accurate. Do not mark something done because the founder says it is done. Check the file exists and has real content in it. If a file exists but is nearly empty, say so.

Keep it under 20 lines so it pastes cleanly.
